Summary
: This essay studies the modes of worship of deities (Devatas) in the Isanasivagurudeva Paddhati (also known as the Tantra Paddhati). This text from the 11th century contains 18,000 Sanskrit verses dealing with a large variety of topics such as architecture and iconography. However this essay focuses on the worship ceremonies and ritual practices associated with Gods, Goddesses and other deities (Devatas).
This essay includes summaries and extracts of English translations of the Isanasivagurudeva Paddhati. Alternative titles: Īśānaśivagurudevapaddhati (ईशानशिवगुरुदेवपद्धति), Īśānaśivagurudeva-paddhati (ईशानशिवगुरुदेव-पद्धति), Īśānaśivaguru-deva (ईशानशिवगुरु-देव), Īśānaśiva-guru (ईशानशिव-गुरु), Isanasivagurudevapaddhati, Ishanashivagurudevapaddhati, Ishanashivagurudeva-paddhati, Ishanashivaguru-deva, Isanasivaguru, Ishanashiva-guru, Isanasiva.
